name: deploy
desc: Deploy the configuration

name: interfaces
desc: interfaces to configure

name: interfaces[*].access_vlan
desc: Access VLAN ID

name: interfaces[*].admin_state
desc: Enable or disable the interface

name: interfaces[*].allowed_vlans
desc: Allowed vlans for the ethernet interface. Allowed values are `none`, `all` or VLAN ranges (1-200,500-2000,3000)

name: interfaces[*].auto_negotiate
desc: Auto Negotiate mode for speed

name: interfaces[*].bpdu_guard
desc: Enable spanning-tree bpduguard: true='enable', false='disable', no='return to default settings'

name: interfaces[*].cdp_enable
desc: Enable CDP on the interface

name: interfaces[*].custom_policy_parameters
desc: Custom policy parameters

name: interfaces[*].disable_ip_redirects
desc: Disable both IPv4/IPv6 redirects on the interface

name: interfaces[*].enable_monitor
desc: Enable switchport monitor for SPAN / ERSPAN

name: interfaces[*].enable_pfc
desc: Enable priority flow control

name: interfaces[*].enable_pim_sparse
desc: Enable PIM sparse-mode on the interface

name: interfaces[*].enable_qos
desc: Enable to configure a QoS Policy for this interface. If AI/ML Queuing is enabled on the fabric, will use the QOS_CLASSIFICATION policy. Enter a custom policy below to override

name: interfaces[*].freeform_config
desc: Additional CLI config (if any) for the interface configuration

name: interfaces[*].guard_mode
desc: Set spanning tree guard mode for the interface, select 'no' to delete the config

name: interfaces[*].ig_for_fex
desc: Shared group for fex ports

name: interfaces[*].interface_description
desc: Interface description

name: interfaces[*].interface_name
desc: Name of the Interface. Example: `Ethernet1/10`

name: interfaces[*].ipv4_address
desc: IPv4 address of the interface

name: interfaces[*].ipv4_prefix_length
desc: IP netmask length used with the IP address (Min:1, Max:31)

name: interfaces[*].ipv6_addr
desc: IPv6 Address: IPv6 address of the Interface

name: interfaces[*].ipv6_prefix_length
desc: IPv6 Prefix Length: Prefix length associated with IPv6 address (Min:64, Max:127)

name: interfaces[*].link_state_routing_protocol
desc: Link-State Routing Protocol: Select link-state routing protocol - Applicable as per template used

name: interfaces[*].link_state_routing_tag
desc: Link-State Routing Tag: Link-state routing protocol tag - Usage as per template used

name: interfaces[*].mtu
desc: MTU for the interface

name: interfaces[*].native_vlan
desc: Set native VLAN for the interface

name: interfaces[*].netflow
desc: Netflow is supported only if it is enabled on fabric

name: interfaces[*].netflow_monitor
desc: Provide the Layer 2 Monitor Name

name: interfaces[*].netflow_sampler
desc: Netflow sampler name, applicable to N7K only

name: interfaces[*].orphan_port
desc: If enabled, configure the interface as a vPC orphan port to be suspended by the secondary peer in vPC failures

name: interfaces[*].p_vlan_assoc_list
desc: Private VLAN host association

name: interfaces[*].p_vlan_assoc_list[*].p_vlan
desc: P Vlan

name: interfaces[*].p_vlan_assoc_list[*].s_vlan
desc: SVlan Id

name: interfaces[*].p_vlan_mapping_list
desc: Private VLAN promiscuous mapping

name: interfaces[*].p_vlan_mapping_list[*].p_vlan
desc: P Vlan

name: interfaces[*].p_vlan_mapping_list[*].s_vlan
desc: SVlan Id

name: interfaces[*].path_cost
desc: Spanning Tree Port Path Cost <1-200000000>

name: interfaces[*].pim_dr_priority
desc: Configure priority for PIM DR election on the interface, default is 1

name: interfaces[*].port_duplex_mode
desc: Configure the port duplex mode

name: interfaces[*].port_type_fast
desc: Enable spanning-tree edge port behavior

name: interfaces[*].ptp
desc: Enable PTP

name: interfaces[*].pvlan_allowed_vlans
desc: Allowed values: 'none', or vlan ranges (ex: 1-200,500-2000,3000)

name: interfaces[*].pvlan_mode
desc: private-vlan mode

name: interfaces[*].pvlan_native_vlan
desc: Native Vlan for private-vlan - valid values 1-4094

name: interfaces[*].qos_policy
desc: Custom QoS Policy must be defined previously

name: interfaces[*].queuing_policy
desc: Queuing Policy must be defined previously

name: interfaces[*].routing_tag
desc: Routing tag associated with interface IP

name: interfaces[*].serial_number
desc: Serial number of switch to configure. This field cannot be specified if `serial_number` is specified in the common block

name: interfaces[*].speed
desc: "Interface speed. Should be one of the following: * `Auto` * `10Mb` * `100Mb` * `1Gb` * `2.5Gb` * `5Gb` * `10Gb` * `25Gb` * `40Gb` * `50Gb` * `100Gb` * `200Gb` * `400Gb`"

name: interfaces[*].ttag
desc: Enable Ttag/Ttag-strip

name: interfaces[*].vrf
desc: Interface VRF name, default VRF if not specified

name: policy
desc: "Policy to be used for the interface. Supported policies: * `int_trunk_host` * `int_access_host` * `int_dot1q_tunnel_host` * `int_monitor_ethernet` * `int_pvlan_host` * `int_routed_host` * `int_shared_trunk_host` * `int_trunk_classic` * `epl_routed_intf` "

name: policy_type
desc: Specifies if the policy is user defined or the default ones available in system

name: serial_number
desc: Serial number of switch to configure. This field cannot be specified if `serial_number` inside `interfaces` block is specified`
